recommendations.title: Buy Detroit Pistons -3.5
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy Detroit Pistons -3.5 at home. The no-vig spread market gives them about a 52% chance to cover, and after our home-court and bucket adjustments we land near 56%. Priced at -118, that works out to roughly +3.9% expected value per dollar, so the side clears our minimum-edge filter.
